result.notes: Bao cao 225 dong: khoa so 24, 27 phut/3 bai hoc (audience creation 15m, Advantage+ 7m, overlap 5m), rating 4.9. Noi dung chinh: 3 loai audience (core/custom/lookalike 1-10%, seed toi thieu 100, khuyen nghi 1000-5000), Advantage+ audience (goi y vs gioi han cung, so Meta 14.8/9.7/7.2%, Andromeda), dau gia Total Value, toi uu reach (Advantage+ placements/budget, Reach and Frequency buying, frequency), cong cu Audience Overlap + cach sua, attribution mac dinh 7-day click/1-day view/1-day engaged view. Doi chieu 159/160/161: Meta bo sung bang du lieu khach hang + retargeting co cau truc + Reach and Frequency; khac han: targeting thanh goi y, overlap la loi cau truc, reach tang bang mo pool. Gioi han trung thuc: video bai giang sau dang nhap (khong xem truc tiep), bao cao 161 chua merge nen doi chieu 161 theo mo ta cong khai, 2 con so overlap chua doi chieu duoc (1000 vs 10000 nguoi; toi da 5 vs 10 audience). Khong dang nhap/thi/chay quang cao that — dung §9.
